title: What a Good Safari Guide Does
excerpt: Your guide makes or breaks your safari. What a good safari guide does, beyond driving and finding animals.
body:
## Spotting

A good guide spots animals you would miss, reads tracks and listens to the bush.

## Knowledge

Animals, plants, birds, geology and culture.

## Ethics

Respect for animals and rules. No chasing or crowding.

## Safety

Calm, alert and experienced.

## Communication

Explains, listens and adjusts to your wishes.

## Story

Many guides grew up near the parks and share their own stories.

See [how guides are trained](/blog/safari-guide-training/) or [plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
